first_safe_runtime_slice.description: A pure resolver maps active buff_offensive/buff_defensive statuses on a battle entity to a stat-delta envelope. The resolver is pure, deterministic, side-effect free. It is NOT called by battle_engine in this slice. Battle runtime keeps current behavior. The first activation pack will wire the resolver behind a flag (STATUS_RUNTIME_BUFF_SLICE_ENABLED) into pre-fight stat application only, never into tick loop.

blockers_for_actual_battle_integration: battle_engine wiring: pre-fight stat application hook needed (NOT present)
VFX pipeline: buff_icon overlay on hero portrait; needs frontend handoff
PvP fairness audit: pre-fight stat injection must be deterministic across both teams
rollback plan: a single env flag must be sufficient to revert the slice
REQUIRED suite augmentation: slice activation pack must add at least 1 REQUIRED validator

test_matrix.description: resolver returns zero envelope for empty status list
resolver respects per-category cap (no envelope > master_cap)
resolver is deterministic: same input → same output
resolver is side-effect free (no DB write, no env mutation)
flag STATUS_RUNTIME_BUFF_SLICE_ENABLED unset → resolver never invoked
